name: unreal-game-studio
description: Make Unreal Engine 5.7 games with an agent studio (director, designer, programmer, audio, QA) that drives the editor through UnrealClaude, plus local music (ACE-Step) and lip-synced faces (NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D).

UNREALCLAUDE_PLUGIN_DIR.title: UnrealClaude plugin folder
UNREALCLAUDE_PLUGIN_DIR.description: Absolute path to the installed UnrealClaude plugin, e.g. C:/MyGame/Plugins/UnrealClaude. Its Resources/mcp-bridge must have had `npm install` run.
